name: skyhold-isles-td
description: Skyhold Isles — hand-painted storybook tower defense across floating sky islands
author: Skyhold Studio

scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.json --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.json --win nsis zip --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.json --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.mobile:build:android:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
